metadata.title: Fezbariz — The House of Elegance Between Fez and Paris
metadata.description: Handmade Moroccan artisanal gandouras and caftans. Shipping in France and worldwide.

home.heroSubtitle: Gandouras and caftans handmade by Moroccan artisans, for you and your family.
home.storyTitle: A craft passed down through generations
home.storyText: Every piece is handmade by Moroccan artisans using traditional techniques: embroidery, weaving and time-honoured finishing. By choosing Fezbariz, you directly support these artisans and help keep a unique heritage alive.

about.title: Our story
about.intro: Fezbariz, the house of elegance between Fez and Paris, was born from a passion for Moroccan textile craftsmanship and a desire to share it beyond borders.
about.missionText: We work directly with artisans and cooperatives in Morocco to offer authentic pieces, handmade following traditional methods, while ensuring fair compensation.
about.qualityText: Every gandoura and caftan is made with care using artisanal techniques passed down through generations.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.intro: A question about a product, an order, or a custom request? Write to us, we'll get back to you quickly.

footer.tagline: The house of elegance between Fez and Paris.
